instrument: scss cause ledger — the whole residual, by type and target shape, with a falsifier per cause
revision: HEAD at measurement (this lane's analyzer carries the owner index; the cursor-walk swap was measured and REVERTED)
runLabel: ONE RUN per instrument. The gate rows are whole-population (4,433 files, 25 repos); the gate's POPULATION block reports 1 file with content returning nothing (the HOLE below), so no residual from that run may be quoted without it.
howTheCausesWereNamed: This walks the same admitted population and classifies every edge with the gate's OWN rule module (`classifyEdge`, the function `incoming-gate.ts:953` calls) and the gate's OWN claim extractor (`externalClaimOf`) — it reproduces the gate's per-type rows exactly (extends 427/235/37/155 · calls 304/278/26 · overrides 32/16/16 · uses 91/91/0). It exists because the gate's printed worklists are CAPPED AT 25 NAMES PER TYPE (measured: imports 297 -> 25, references 1,501 -> 25, exports 983 -> 25), so the printed list cannot be read as the residual.

causes.MODULE-PATH 272: a Sass module specifier (@use/@forward/@import) that names no admitted file and no published symbol. FALSIFIER MEASURED: for each of the 272 the path's basename was looked up in the project's own declaration census — **10 could have resolved** by basename (3.7%), so 262 have no referent BY CONSTRUCTION; the 10 are the only lane-fixable slice and are named in the artifact. THE 10 CANDIDATES ARE RULED, NOT FIXED, and the ruling reaches the build system: they are all one file, `consul/ui/packages/consul-ui/app/styles/components.scss`, importing specifiers like `consul-ui/components/table`. The file they name DOES exist — at `ui/packages/consul-ui/app/components/table/index.scss` — but the specifier's own first segment `consul-ui/` names NO directory in the repository (not tracked: `git ls-files | grep -c '^consul-ui/'` = 0; not a directory; not in the build's `includePaths`). It is a directory the BUILD CREATES: `ember-cli-build.js:121` runs `new Funnel('app', { include: ['components/**/*.{scss,css}'], destDir: 'consul-ui' })`, so `consul-ui/components/table` means `app/components/table` only after the build has synthesized that name. A corpus-relative resolver cannot reach it, and the analyzer is right not to claim `importProjectFile` for a path it cannot name. FALSIFIER: if a tracked directory `consul-ui/` existed, or an `includePaths` entry named it, the specifier WOULD be corpus-resolvable and the claim would be required — measured: neither holds.
causes.URL 10: a remote stylesheet (`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=...`). No admitted file can be named by a URL — ruled by construction, and the shape is a specifier, not a declaration.
causes.BARE-IDENT 15: a bare package name (`admonition`, `docstring` from a directory `@forward`). classifyEdge already asked the project census: 0 declarations of that name, so the referent is outside the population.

causes.SELECTOR 182: `@extend .is-dark`, `%block`, `h1` — a selector the population does not declare: the class/placeholder lives in a dependency that is not in the corpus, or the extend targets a built-in element. classifyEdge found no declaration of the name in the project; the MODULE-PATH counterfactual on this type reads 0 could-have-resolved.
causes.BARE-IDENT 10: the same shape without a leading `.`/`%`.

causes.BARE-IDENT 787: name collisions/unresolved reads; 6,257 sibling edges on this type carry a VERIFIED claim (the gate's extOK 3,733 are the file claims). The S1/S2 split from `docs/analyzers/scss.md` applies: S1 = every declaration of the name is in the edge's OWN file (a scoping failure, repairable — 3 in a 600-file window), S2 = >1 file, one kind (the published-name contract: `.btn` in two stylesheets is two rules that both call themselves `.btn`).

causes.BARE-IDENT 983: one `exports` edge per public module member (2,501 distinct variables on the widest file alone) whose name is not a unique identifier across the project — the same published-name contract as references S2, counted on the member side.

causes.SELECTOR 26: an animation/`@keyframes` selector name declared in no admitted file.

causes.SELECTOR 18 + FRAGMENT 3: 18 containment targets are selectors no file declares; the 3 FRAGMENT targets are IDREF-style `#id` selectors, which name a NODE and not a declaration of that name (the same shape ruled on the xml lane).

causes.BARE-IDENT 16: a module-level `!default` override whose target name is declared in >1 file.

causes.\u2014: 91 edges, all resolved. §6.11: the case that would make this non-zero is an `animation:` name matching no `@keyframes` declaration in the project; none exists on this population.

instrumentObservation.what: the gate's printed residual (3,015 = 2,563 amb + 452 unresolved) is CLAIM-BLIND in its ambiguity column: this enumeration, using the gate's own classifier and claim extractor, finds 2,322 — 693 fewer — because 693 edges carry a VERIFIED claim and are still counted as `amb(decl)` in the printed row (references: printed amb 1,499 against 787 claim-aware).
instrumentObservation.whyItMatters: a lane reading its own row would size the work as 3,015 where 693 already carry verified external claims. The `unresolved` column IS claim-aware (imports 3,405 -> 297 is exactly the claim subtraction) — the two columns are not computed the same way.
instrumentObservation.reportedNotFixed: script/m14/incoming-gate.ts is not this lane's file.

hole: the same run's POPULATION block reports 1 file with CONTENT that returned nothing — bulma/docs/vendor/fontawesome-free-6.5.2-web/scss/_variables.scss (the wide-ERROR-node timeout, see hole-finding.json). Every number above is a count over a population with that hole in it, and 1 file was degraded (regex fallback).

scopingSplit.measuredOn: the current revision, whole admitted population, ONE RUN
scopingSplit.vocabulary: the lane's own (docs/analyzers/scss.md): S1 = every declaration of the name is in the edge's OWN file; S2 = >1 file, one kind; S3 = >1 file, >1 kind
scopingSplit.S1_verdict: 13, ALL `contains`, ALL with NO `line_number`, each target declared exactly twice in its own file. The analyzer's Rule 2b disambiguates same-named targets by the edge's line and DECLINES without one, so the bare name stands. The omission is deliberate (`real-css-analyzer.ts:2212-2217`: a COMPOSED name gets no line, 'never checkable rather than silently unaccused'), and the emission is in a shared file outside this lane, so it is HANDED OVER, not landed — see s1-finding.json for the patch shape and the falsifier.
scopingSplit.S1_is_not_zero_and_that_is_the_measureme: the Lead's ask was 'fixed or shown to be 0'. It is 13, one cause, with the owner named and a falsifier that predicts 0 after the emission carries the contained rule's own line.
